course_description_reviews.name: Introduction to Applied Artificial Intelligence
course_description_reviews.description: Introduces applied-AI technologies, programming tools, business problem solving, and responsible technology use.
course_description_reviews.rationale: Applied-AI technologies are central, with introductory programming and ethics serving that stated goal.

course_description_reviews.name: Application of AI/ML in Finance and Beyond
course_description_reviews.description: Applies machine-learning and AI models to finance and broader corporate decisions.
course_description_reviews.source_title: Application of AI/ML in Finance and Beyond
course_description_reviews.rationale: The description explicitly focuses on ML/AI models and techniques, rather than finance alone.

course_description_reviews.name: Data-Driven Marketing: Analytics, Insights and Applied AI
course_description_reviews.description: Integrates AI, machine learning, and data-science tools into marketing decisions and customer engagement.
course_description_reviews.source_title: Data-Driven Marketing: Analytics, Insights and Applied AI
course_description_reviews.rationale: Specific AI/ML and data-science techniques are the central analytic tools described.

course_description_reviews.name: Artificial Intelligence in Supply Chain
course_description_reviews.description: Applies AI and machine learning to forecasting, inventory, logistics, warehouses, and supplier decisions.
course_description_reviews.rationale: Machine-learning and AI-powered decision systems are central stated methods.

course_description_reviews.name: Ethics, Governance, and Responsible Use in AI
course_description_reviews.description: Studies ethical implications, governance, risk, transparency, and accountability in organizational AI deployment.
course_description_reviews.source_title: Ethics, Governance, and Responsible Use in AI
course_description_reviews.rationale: Ethics, governance and responsible social/organizational deployment form the subject rather than model construction.

course_description_reviews.name: FinTech Foundations and Applications
course_description_reviews.description: Builds financial-technology business concepts using AI tools, automation, APIs, and machine-learning bots.
course_description_reviews.rationale: The experiential course combines pitching/valuation and multiple technologies to produce financial applications; AI is one tool within the domain project.

course_description_reviews.name: Identifying, Building, Creating and Communicating FinTech Opportunities
course_description_reviews.description: Identifies and communicates financial-technology opportunities across AI, digital assets, contracts, and blockchain.
course_description_reviews.source_title: Identifying, Building, Creating and Communicating FinTech Opportunities
course_description_reviews.rationale: FinTech opportunity analysis spans several technologies, with AI as one of them; financial application is the common subject.

course_description_reviews.name: Leveraging AI with Predictive Analytics
course_description_reviews.description: Builds predictive business models using regression, decision trees, clustering, and time-series methods.
course_description_reviews.rationale: Machine-learning model design and implementation are explicit primary activities.

course_description_reviews.name: Harnessing the Decision-Making Power of AI with Prescriptive Analytics
course_description_reviews.description: Uses optimization, simulation, heuristics, and prescriptive analytical methods for business decisions.
course_description_reviews.source_title: Harnessing the Decision-Making Power of AI with Prescriptive Analytics
course_description_reviews.rationale: The description centers on mathematical optimization and simulation; the AI title alone does not establish AI methods.

limitations: 2026-2027 Edition is explicit in official bulletin pages.
